def factor_vol_regime_gated_momentum_volume_confirm_v2(df):
    """Adaptive momentum signal gated by volume regime from classify_volume_regime, confirmed by volume ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    mom_short = close / close.shift(5) - 1
    mom_long = close / close.shift(20) - 1
    w = np.clip(vol_ratio - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    blend_signal = w * mom_short + (1 - w) * mom_long
    high_mask = is_high_vol > 0
    low_mask = is_low_vol > 0
    signal = np.where(high_mask, mom_short, np.where(low_mask, mom_long, blend_signal))
    factor = signal * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_vol_regime_gated_momentum_volume_confirm_v2"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_regime_gated_momentum_volume_confirm_v2"]
